operations.title: A rank-one geometric excess line realizes each algebraic overlap bridge with exactly one Pochhammer normal factor.

operations.title: Compute one actual excess cotangent complex, its loaded five-term pentagon current, and the four-transition holonomy.
operations.summary: Falsify the conjecture if the excess rank is not one, its Thom boundary has different weights, tangential/lower-face terms fail the five-term identity, or the product of the four oriented PC transitions is not the identity.
